page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head at the top, the page number and gathering signature at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: XXVI. Pet. à Valle. Jo. Morino. Respon-sio ad praecedentem Epistolam. Ephe-merides Persicae ac Turcicae, quas penes se asservabat Auctor tabularum, Astronomicarum, quibus nunc Persae utuntur, & de his judicium diagram-ma Triacontaëterides Arabicae, quam ab Astronomo Persa habuerat.

XXVII. Jo. Morinus Illustrissimo Cardi-nali Barberino scribit Apologiam li-bri, cui nomen fuerat, De la Grandeur & Souveraineté temporelle donée à l' Eglise Romaine, ob cuius editionem malè au-diebat Morinus apud Aulicos urbis.
XXVIII. Renatus Gœzaldus Jo. Morino de iis, quae Romani Aulici in ejus libro notaverant.
XXIX. Jo. Morinus Dom. Soari, cui impositum fuerat onus à Cardin. Bar-berino, in opus illud inquirendi.
XXX. Idem eidem, Soarem sibi devinci-re conatur Morinus.

page.notes: The printed text is clear. Doubtful: the mark after "tabularum" may be a comma or a dash; I transcribed a comma. The entries are numbered, so they are paragraphs, not headings. Printed "cujus" and "inqvirendi" were normalised to "cuius" and "inquirendi" under the i/j and u/v rule; the printed spelling is otherwise kept.
